name: com.miui.zeus.mimo.sdk.ad.reward.RewardVideoAdActivityMiniGame
sdkName: Xiaomi Mobile Ads Alliance (Mimo Ad SDK)
description: Xiaomi MiMo uses this Activity to run reward ads in mini-games. Depending on the ad, it shows playable content or a video.
disableEffect: Reward videos will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.
